Documentation.UserDocu:
A 3D sketch: constrained geometry in 3D, in an attachable frame of its own.
Geometry ids: 0 and up are the sketch's own geometry; -1, -2, -3 are the frame's X, Y and Z axes (-1 start is the origin), -4, -5, -6 its XY, YZ and ZX planes, and -7 and down the external references in the order they were added.

solve() -> int
Solve the sketch and update the geometry. Returns 0 on success, -1 if the solver fails, -3 for conflicting constraints, -4 for redundant ones (the geometry is still updated) and -5 for constraints a 3D sketch cannot solve.

addGeometry(geo, construction=False) -> int or tuple
Add a Part.Point, LineSegment, Circle, ArcOfCircle, BSplineCurve or Plane (a fixed workplane, always construction), or a list of them. Returns the index or indices.
delGeometry(index): remove a geometry and the constraints on it.

addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint or list) -> int or tuple
Types and their 3D meaning: Coincident; PointOnObject (on a line, circle, arc, spline, plane or external edge); AlongX / AlongY / AlongZ (a line, or two points); Parallel and Perpendicular (lines, or a line and a plane); Tangent (two lines: collinear; end to end: joined and tangent); Equal; Symmetric about a point (the midpoint); Distance (a line, two points, a point and a line or plane); DistanceX / DistanceY / DistanceZ; Angle (two lines); Radius; Diameter; Block; and the B-spline internal alignments.
delConstraint(index)
setDatum(index or name, value or Quantity): set a dimension and solve.
getDatum(index or name) -> Quantity
setDriving(index, bool): a driving dimension, or a reference that measures.
renameConstraint(index, name): a name an expression can use; '' unnames it
setConstruction(index, bool)

addExternal(obj, subname) -> int
Refer to a model vertex, edge or planar face, or a datum, taken as it is (no projection). Returns its geometry id.
delExternal(geoId): remove an external reference and the constraints on it.

fillet(geo1, pos1, geo2, pos2, radius) -> int
A corner fillet: the arc tangent to two lines whose given ends meet, in their plane, the lines trimmed back to it. Returns the arc's geometry id.

movePoint(geoId, pos, Vector, relative=False) -> int
Drag a point (pos 1 start, 2 end, 3 centre) or a whole curve (pos 0) with the constraints kept. Returns 0 when it solved.
The degrees of freedom the last solve left.
